allowance_taper.source: GOV.UK, Income Tax rates and allowances for current and previous tax years: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/rates-and-allowances-income-tax/income-tax-rates-and-allowances-current-and-past

scottish_bands_note: Amounts of taxable income above the personal allowance. HMRC gives the Advanced band's top as £125,140 (the gross figure) because the allowance has tapered to nil by then.
scottish_bands_source: GOV.UK, Rates and thresholds for employers 2025 to 2026: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/rates-and-thresholds-for-employers-2025-to-2026; gov.scot, Scottish Income Tax technical factsheet: https://www.gov.scot/publications/scottish-income-tax-technical-factsheet/

national_insurance.source: GOV.UK, Rates and thresholds for employers 2025 to 2026 (Class 1, category A): https://www.gov.uk/guidance/rates-and-thresholds-for-employers-2025-to-2026

nhs_scotland_pension_note: Tiers are on actual pensionable pay, not whole-time equivalent. 'tiers' is the table for new starters and in-year pay changes (current annualised pay); 'continuing' is for members tiered on the previous year's pay (2024/25), the table the household's old childcare calculator used.
nhs_scotland_pension_source: SPPA NHS Circular 2025/07, Employee contribution tiers 2025-26: https://pensions.gov.scot/sites/default/files/2025-07/NHS_Circular_2025-07_Employee_contribution_tiers_2025-26.pdf

child_benefit.source: GOV.UK, Tax credits, Child Benefit and Guardian's Allowance rates: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/rates-and-allowances-tax-credits-child-benefit-and-guardians-allowance/tax-credits-child-benefit-and-guardians-allowance

high_income_child_benefit_charge.note: 1% of Child Benefit repaid for every £200 of adjusted net income over £60,000; all of it from £80,000.
high_income_child_benefit_charge.source: GOV.UK, High Income Child Benefit Charge: https://www.gov.uk/child-benefit-tax-charge

tax_free_childcare.note: The government adds £2 for every £8 paid in, up to £500 a quarter (£2,000 a year) per child.

funded_childcare.note: From the term after the third birthday until school. Councils set the actual term dates (August, January, March or April); the month here is the usual one.
funded_childcare.source: mygov.scot, Funded early learning and childcare: https://www.mygov.scot/childcare-costs-help/funded-early-learning-and-childcare; SSI 2014/196 art. 1: https://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2014/196/article/1
